question: Which of the following palaces is located in Mysore, Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amba Vilas Palace**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Amba Vilas Palace, also known as the Mysore Palace, is located in Mysore, Karnataka.
 
• It is one of the most famous tourist attractions in India, drawing millions of visitors each year.
 
• The palace is the official residence of the Wadiyar dynasty and the seat of the Kingdom of Mysore.
 
• The architectural style of the palace is a blend of Hindu, Muslim, Rajput, and Gothic styles.
 
• The palace is renowned for its grandeur and intricate interior decorations, including stained glass windows, domes, and expansive halls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Mysore Palace**

 
 
• The current structure of the Mysore Palace was commissioned in 1897 and completed in 1912 after a fire destroyed the old palace.
 
• It was designed by the British architect Henry Irwin.
 
 
 
• **Dasara Festival**
 
 
• The Mysore Palace is the focal point of the annual Dasara festival, which is celebrated with great pomp and splendor.
 
• The palace is illuminated with thousands of lights during the festival, making it a spectacular sight.
 
 
 
• **Architectural Features**
 
 
• The palace features a three-story stone structure with marble domes and a 145-foot five-story tower.
 
• Its Durbar Hall is known for its beautiful stained glass ceiling and ornate chandeliers.
 
 
 
• **Tourist Information**
 
 
• The palace is open to visitors throughout the year, with special guided tours available.
 
• Photography is allowed only in the outer premises, not inside the palace.
